actions.description: Retrieve the active recurring/usage subscription for an app on a shop.
actions.name: get-active-subscription

appId.description: Shopify app GID using the shopify namespace. Example: "gid://shopify/App/1234567890"

shopId.description: Shopify shop GID using the shopify namespace. Example: "gid://shopify/Shop/1234567890"

actions.description: List the Partner API versions supported by this account.
actions.name: get-public-api-versions

actions.description: List historical events for a single known Partner app.
actions.name: list-app-events

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

first.description: Number of events to return per page. Default: 50.

shopId.description: Shop GID to filter by. Example: gid://partners/Shop/1234

occurredAtMin.description: Return events on or after this ISO 8601 datetime.

occurredAtMax.description: Return events on or before this ISO 8601 datetime.

actions.description: List Partner account events across apps and shops with filters.
actions.name: list-events

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return. Defaults to 50.

shopId.description: Filter by shop ID. Must be a GID in the format gid://shopify/Shop/{id}.

subjectId.description: Filter by subject ID. Must be a GID in the format gid://shopify/App/{id} or gid://shopify/Theme/{id}.

eventTypes.description: Filter by one or more event types.

occurredAtMin.description: Filter events that occurred on or after this ISO 8601 datetime.

occurredAtMax.description: Filter events that occurred on or before this ISO 8601 datetime.

actions.description: List Partner transactions with cursor pagination and filters.
actions.name: list-transactions

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

first.description: Number of results to return. Defaults to 50, maximum 100.

actions.description: Run a constrained Partner API GraphQL query for cases the typed actions do not cover.
actions.name: query-partner-data

query.description: A read-only GraphQL query string. Every object ID argument must be a full GID (e.g. gid://partners/App/123, gid://shopify/Shop/456).

syncs.description: Sync Partner account events (installs, charges, credits, earnings, subscription status changes).
syncs.name: events
